name: React Grab
summary: Shortcut that copies a UI element's file name, React component and HTML source for pasting into a coding agent.
description: Dev tool for React projects: hover over any UI element in the browser and press Cmd/Ctrl+C to copy its file name, React component and HTML source to the clipboard, ready to paste into a coding agent. Installed with a CLI (npx grab@latest init) that detects Next.js, Vite or Webpack and adds the needed scripts; manual npm installation is documented too.
contains: hover + Cmd/Ctrl+C copies file name, React component and HTML source
CLI detects the framework and adds scripts automatically
supports Next.js App router, Next.js Pages router, Vite and Webpack
install via npx grab@latest init or manual package
works with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
